acceptance_predicates.description: TUI selected/all workload recording drives the runner-owned bounded campaign and complete coverage gate.
TUI surfaces duplicate, mismatched, corrupt, and incomplete capture failures without publishing partial readiness.
TUI strict replay consumes an exact sealed cassette while provider network contact is denied.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management never block mock recording or replay.

definition_of_done: Exact paired receipt covers selected/all recording, sealing, incomplete coverage, and offline replay.
Independent review, hosted checks, and no-secret scan pass.

gates.description: Replay is exact-compatible with the selected provider and agent and does not fall back live.
